pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
vocavi ex nomine Beseleel filium Uri filii Hur de tribu Juda,
I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah,
and I have filled him with the Spirit of God,
ad excogitandum quidquid fabrefieri potest ex auro,
in order to design whatever must be fabricated from gold,
Dedique ei socium Ooliab filium Achisamech de tribu Dan.
And I have given to him, as his associate, Oholiab the son of Ahisamach,
Et in corde omnis eruditi posui sapientiam:
from the tribe of Dan. And I have placed wisdom in the heart of every artisan,
ut faciant cuncta quæ præcepi tibi,
so that they may make everything as I have instructed you:
and the ark of the testimony,
et propitiatorium, quod super eam est,
and the propitiatory which is over it,
and all the vessels of the tabernacle,
and the table and its vessels,
the most pure lampstand with its vessels,
vestes sanctas in ministerio Aaron sacerdoti,
the holy vestments for the ministry of Aaron the priest,
ut fungantur officio suo in sacris:
so that they may execute their office of sacred rites,
and the incense of aromatics in the Sanctuary.
All the things that I have instructed you,
Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
and you shall say to them:
See that you keep my Sabbath.
quia signum est inter me et vos in generationibus vestris:
For it is a sign between me and you among your generations,
so that you may know that I am the Lord,
for it is holy to you.
Whoever will have done any work in it,
peribit anima illius de medio populi sui.
his soul shall perish from the midst of his people.
For six days you shall do work.
omnis qui fecerit opus in hac die,
a rest sanctified by the Lord.
All who will have done work on this day shall die.
Let the sons of Israel keep the Sabbath,
et celebrent illud in generationibus suis.
and let them celebrate it throughout their generations.
between me and the sons of Israel,
sex enim diebus fecit Dominus cælum et terram,
For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth,
et in septimo ab opere cessavit.
and in the seventh he ceased from work.”
completis hujuscemodi sermonibus in monte Sinai,
having completed speaking in this way on Mount Sinai,
gave to Moses two stone tablets of testimony,
written with the finger of God.
